Fɔtsa ɛna a kĩ fudzi nkpã a sã kamu, obu, mɔ kɔlɛkanyɛ tɔnɔ kakpa oti a kĩ edzi nɛ lɛgãkpo akũ, kĩ edzi nkpã daa daa a.
Fukĩĩ aafɔ̃ kĩ ntɛ mbuki ĩya nɛ mi sɛkɛ̃ ni, míapuli mipia nɛ yĩ akũ kĩ mikɛna ɔmɔa mɔ Kristo Yesu.
Kitonɛkĩ Kristo táwo ɛnaa Patampa Kpalɛwa a kĩ batidziwa like, kĩ ɛnyɛ ode fude a odi kuyo a kamɛ.
Lɛmɛ boe kɔ̃ bɔamanɛ akũ ayekĩ bɔ́ana lɛgãbɔɛ a kĩ lɛláawɔ da.
Oti kĩ ɛbɛ̃ flee nɛ ode lɛgãkanyakɔ̃ a nyɛ oti a kĩ ɛdɔla ye akũ, ɛdani ɛkɛna ndɛ obisɛ̃ kĩĩ aye.
Nɛ foesũ mabi mi paa nviã kĩĩ, kĩ ntɛ odi yɛla ye nkpã ni, nnɛ́ yĩ nfumusu fɔanɛ.
Ade odi nyɛ odi kĩ bɛtámɔ ye dĩ nɛ nkpã ovoli a kamɛ ni, bɛta ye bido nɛ fi lutubu baũ a kamɛ.
” Ade awã ebuki eke Yesu aduli mɔ ɔsĩ mɔ ɔsĩ kĩ ɛtablɔmɛna be ɛnɛmɛna nɛ tite a na kamɛ a.
Petro tomɛna nɛ liti flee, ɛyawo nɛ Ɔsɔfɔnɔkɔɛ̃ Flee a lɔwabe.
Kĩ Yesu lɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ eyua a, ɛdzakũ nɛ Galilea ɛnaa Yudea amantam nɛ Yordan ɔwɔ liti a.
Petro lɛmɛ tomɔ be ɛna nɛ liti flee.
Luwi nyɛ luwi, babo anɛ kanɛ lɔlɔ kawũ babi beblebee.
Foesũ kĩ Yesu nu fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ a, ɛdzakũ nɛ Yudea emuniki ɛnaa Galilea tite akũ.
Nɛ ke kawũna a, ɛnyɛ ye akũ ɛtsa yĩ malo, titɔ kĩ nkɛna ndɛ oti kĩ bɛtáma ye nɛ lɔkɔ wĩ kamɛ.
” Ke liti a, etu eboomu babisɛ̃ a, ade ete awɛ nɛ be akũ ehila be a.
Ade lɔkɔ a na Baguma aakɔa kamu ɛkpa odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛfɛta ɛkpa kamu a.
Finyaa kɔɛ kpale a yidza kɔdza nɛ ɔmatsɔ̃ a kĩ sɛmɛ pi ye a anɛ kamɛ, kĩ ntɛ esila ɛma pɛ kɔ́abɔɛ obisɛ̃ a kɔmɛna.
Yudafɔ Abodoo Kĩ Ɛtáyila Luwi a kĩ bavɛ Wuda Katɛ̃ Luwi a kanya wo ɔtɔ.
Yohanes Mui Ɔwɔlanɛ a ya, ɛkasui onukpɛ̃, ɛtámɔa waĩ, lɛmɛ milɛ kĩ, ‘Hũhũ kpa deĩ nɛ ye kamɛ!
Mifɔ̃ bumu Baguma, boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo Ɔlɛga a!
Kĩ ewo nɛ ɔmatɔ a koletia a, ɛtsɛlamɔ bati kɔdza kĩ bɛnɔnɛ ɔnɔkpa banaabila.
Ntɛ bɔakɛna nɛ Baguma mbla a akũ ni, fɔ́afɔ̃ bɔmɔ́ buyi ɔsũ kĩ bunyina ye.
Ade Yesu bi otsole a kĩ, “Nɔ katɛkado tɛ nɔ.
Ɔsa maana nɛ mi sɛkɛ̃ sukuloo nɛ osili lɔkɔ flee a, lɔkɔa ntɛ madzakũ ni, míapuli mibumɔ yĩ nɛ yĩ osi akũ kanaa kamɛ nɛ kakɔ nyɛ kakɔ.
Ade Abonsam wo nɛ Yuda kĩ bavɛ Iskariot, kĩ ɛnyɛ fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ ewua-nviã a kamɛ ɔmɔa kamɛ a.
Bɛtákpa be osi kĩ balɛ kɔdzɛla, ade Yudafɔ mbla lɛmɛ tsa kĩ bɛtanya lɔtɔ nɛ adzuma adima kamɛ a.
Nɛ lɔkɔ a naa kamɛ a, Yudafɔ ɔnɔkɔɛ̃ mɔa na kĩ ɛnyɛ Farisini, kĩ bavɛ Nikodemo.
Bati flee aakesĩ mi nɛ yĩ sũ, lɛmɛ oti a kĩ yaadza pintii kɛnaawo kawũna ni, Baguma aakpa ye nkpã.
Ade Yesu bi ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a kĩ, “Mifɔ̃ bati a bidzi nɛ kutsukutsu kamɛ.
Nɛ nhihiɛ kĩĩ onukpɛ̃ ni, Hũhũ Kpalɛwa a nyɛ ɛtsa kĩ, nɛ ayekĩ patampa atɔnyade a buki ɛdzɛ̃ sũ ni, osi tábinya kĩ bati biwo nɛ Kakɔ Kpalɛwa Flee a kamɛ.
Yesu kpa be mbuayɛ kĩ, “Nnɛ́ odi nyɛ odi aapuli enu fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ kayɔ, mbɔɛntɛ bikĩ Baguma kpa be foe a.
Aristarko, kĩ bɔmɔ ye waa kɔla a, awɔ̃na mi.
Ndia aatomɛna mui a kĩ bakpa nkpã a?
“Ntɛ odi nu yĩ fɔlɛtsa a mɔ́ ɛtákɛna nɛ foe akũ ni, nláadzɛmɔ ye.
Yĩ Paulo, Silvano mɔ Timoteo, bɔtsɛlɛ ovoli kĩĩ bɔama mi a kĩ minyɛ Baguma boe Ɔlɛga mɔ boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo bade a nɛ Tesalonika a.
Baavɛ ye Imanuel,” kĩ de kayɔ nyɛ, “Baguma deĩ mɔ boe.
Lɛmɛ ntɛ mikɛna tuwĩ mɔ mido ɔwɔlɛ mimɔ́ lubo nɛ foe kamɛ ni, Baguma aahila mi.
Pilato via ye kĩ, “Nɔ nyɛ Yudafɔ Lɛgã a?
Foesũ mimɔ fɔlɛtsa badzɛnɛ a mibi sodzafɔ lɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ a kĩ, ebuki ɛkɔa Paulo ɛyamɛna nɛ katsɛnakɔ̃ nɛ awĩ.
Awã kĩ adzapadiɛ akũ ovoli deĩ ni, baákɛna ye akũ adzuma ntɛ bɛtámɔ́ foe kamɛ kĩ ovoli a ɔkɔnanɛ ku, kitonɛkĩ adzapadiɛ akũ ovoli lɛnyɛ́ lɛtsama ntɛ oti a kĩ ɛkɛna ye a dzi nkpã.
Nɛ Yesu Kristo Nazaretni dĩ akũ ni, mabi nɔ kĩ yidza kadza, katsã!
Lɛmɛ yaabuki ɛtɛ kɔya ɛkpa nɔ ɛba ndɛ ɔsate aye, ade yaabuki ɛnya ɔwaɛ̃nyole nɛ boe Ɔlate dĩ akũ a.
Lɛmɛ kĩ bati kɔdabu a nu foe a, bitomɔ ye bɛnaa awã.
Owi tábuna ɔwɛ kpale odi do kavũ awɛ, ɛbɔa mui eko nɛ ɔkɔlɔ a kamɛ.
Bakɔa fumakɛ kĩ fɔsa a kĩ bɛtsɛlɛ Baguma fɔlɛtsa bite kabɔa nɛ nnyɛ mɔ akpɔ.
Kĩ ɛkã ovoli a eyua a, evia Paulo amantam a kĩ eto.
“Yudafɔ flee nyina ayekĩ ndzi nkpã kito yĩ tibisɛ̃ kamɛ nɛ boe ɔtɔ mɔ Yerusalem lɛmɛ.
Kɛnɛ kĩ ekĩ yadu mɔ ekĩ yakpɔta a flee bakɛna adzuma a mɔ kɔnɛte kĩ baana be tsɛfã nɛ funitsã a kĩ fɔ́anɛ a kamɛ.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ yaalɛ kɔdzɛla etia Otidziwa Obi a ni, baakɔa bite ye, lɛmɛ odi nyɛ odi kĩ yaalɛ kɔdzɛla etia Hũhũ Kpalɛwa a ni, bɛláakɔa bite ye finyaa ĩye nɛ lɔkɔ a kĩ laya a kamɛ.
Ɛbɔa afɔliɛ deedimɔapɛ ɛkpa fɔkɔ a flee, nɛ lɔkɔ a kĩ ɛkɔa ye akũ ɛbɔa afɔliɛ a.
Foesũ bɔáwɛ kĩ bɔalɛ bati limu boe, mbom kĩ boe kɔdzɛla kalɛ aawo Baguma a kĩ enyina bati ɔwɔlɛ kamɛ a anɛ.
Titɔ kĩ bɛtámɔ tɔkpa tidima nɛ ye akũ malo ni, bɛkɔ ye kɔtɔ ade bɛfɔ̃ Pilato kpa osi bɛkɔ ye a.
Boe Ɔlate, kĩ ntsɛ̃ nɛ osi manaa mɔ suwa ketee a, mmɔ́ ɔhaĩ odi kĩ ɛkpalɛ ɛba suwa, kĩ ɛmɔanɛ eto ode ɛyako nɛ bɔmɔ́ bikĩ bɔtsɛ̃ bɔanaa akũ.
Edeĩ fɔlɔ evũkɔnɔ mɔ tɛlɛ ewua, ade lɛgãbɔɛ tsanɛ nɛ ɔlɛ odi nyɛ odi akũ a.
Ade nɛ lɔkɔ a na kamɛ a, Yudafɔ kĩ bavila Baguma kĩ bito fude kumɛkumɛ nɛ katinya kamɛ flee a ya bideĩ nɛ Yerusalem.
Mui wĩ mɔ lɛdɛmɛ mui aapuli bɛnɛ nɛ lɔwɔkɛ mɔa kamɛ?
Midɔla mi akũ mikpa Lɛgãnɔkɔɛ̃ Flefle a kĩ lideĩ otumi lɛbɛ̃ flee a.
Ntɛ binu pɛ lɔkɔa Abonsam yanyɛ foe nɛ be fɔlɔ kamɛ.
Mite anɛ kĩ nɛ lɔkɔ na kamɛ a, mina mɔ lugo nɛ Kristo sɛkɛ̃.
Kĩ bɛkadã ye a, Yesu akũ dani nɛ be anɛ kamɛ.
Hũhũ adi nyɛ adi kĩ yalɛ kĩ Yesu Kristo ya nɛ katinya kamɛ ndɛ otidziwa aye ni, eto Baguma sɛkɛ̃.
Luwi daa manyɛ yĩ Baguma kɔlɛ nɛ mi lɔlɔ kĩ ɛtsã Yesu Kristo akũ ɛmɔ mi kɔnya.
Ade Yesu bi be kĩ, “Mikɔa foe mima yĩ nɛ awĩ.
Ke liti a, ɛnyɛ ye akũ ɛtsa bikĩ bitomɔ ye kĩ bɛbɛ̃ bati ɔha elo nɛ lɔkɔ mɔa kamɛ, ade be kamɛ badi pii dzi nkpã kɛyawo nviã kĩĩ lɛmɛ be pii tɛ̃ kuwa liti.
Lɛmɛ Paulo tátunɔ kɔlaa kitonɛkĩ, kĩ bɛnaa Pamfilia a, Yohanes Marko dzakũ ɛfɔnɛ be nɛ awã ade ɛtábumɔ be biyua adzuma a.
” Ade ke ɛkpa sodzafɔ a kĩ bɛdza nɛ awã a kɔbɛ̃ kĩ bɛkɔa Paulo bido nɛ kɔla a kĩ Lɛgã Herodes ke a kamɛ lɔkɔa bɛkaadã ye akũ.
” -Nɛ ayekĩ ye ɔtɔ bati tátɛ ye bido sũ ni, fɔlɛtsa a nyɛnɛ Yesu akũ.
Ɛwɛ bikĩ bɛnyɛ ye bade nɛ katinya kamɛ a kalɛ, ade ɛwɛ be kalɛ kɛnawo kawũnakɔ̃ a.
ade bati a kĩ bɛtsɔɛ ye lɔtsɔɛ nɛ sɛklabi a lɛmɛ aamɔ ye.
Ntsɛlɛ ovoli kĩĩ mamɛna nɔ, ade matɛ kado kĩ aakɛna nɛ lɛtsa a kĩ mavia nɔ a akũ a.
Ayekĩ bati kɔdabu a kĩ kɔtsɛna nɛ ye akũ a tɛ́nɛ kapɔ sũ ni, ewo edzi nɛ ɔkɔlɔ kamɛ ade kɔdabu a dza nɛ ɔwɔ abuĩ a.
Kavelibi a deĩ tɛlɛ evũkɔnɔ mɔ banebi evũkɔnɔ kĩ fɔnyɛ Baguma hũhũ evũkɔnɔ a kĩ edo nɛ tite flee akũ a.
Ɛkɛna foe nɛ Abodoo Kĩ Ɛtáyila Fuwi Kanya a kamɛ.
Ntɛ bati vũna mi kĩ mi nɛ ayekĩ mitomɔ Kristo sũ ni, kawɔlɛ kide mi, kitonɛkĩ kukũkpalɛ Hũhũ a, kĩ ɛnyɛ Baguma Hũhũ a tomɔ mi.
Nɛ fukĩĩ sũ, yĩ ndɛ awaɛ̃ nɛ Kristo kamɛ aye a, maapuli nkɔa otumi mbi nɔ kĩ kɛna lɛtsa a kĩ kɛnɛ kĩ kɛna.
Kitonɛkĩ fude flee mɔa ye adɔpaa akũ kalɔkpa bavɛ a.
Oti a kĩ eyi lɛgãkanyakɔ̃ ɛkpa boe kĩ bɔnya basɔfɔ busum ye Baguma mɔ Ɔlɛga a, ade ye mɔ mikɔa kukũkpalɛ mɔ kɔbɛ̃ mikpa daa daa!
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ yakɛna tɔkpa ni, efum Baguma mbla a, kitonɛkĩ tɔkpa nyɛ Baguma mbla kafum.
Kĩ Paulo mɔ́ be a, ɛnyɛ Baguma kɔlɛ ade ke ebuki ɛna ɔwɔlɛ kado a.
Katɛkado lɛfɔ̃ kĩ Mose bo anɛ a, esĩ kĩ bɛtavɛ ye kĩ Egipte Lɛgã obitsole obi.
Oti wĩ anyɛ fɔtsa wĩ kanya katomɛna ye fɔtsa wĩ kakɔlakɔ̃, ade oti kpa lɛmɛ anyɛ fɔtsa kpa kanya katomɛna ye fɔtsa kpa kakɔlakɔ̃ a.
Foesũ kĩ bɛya nɛ awĩ a, ntátɛ̃ ndzi nɛ kalɛ kĩĩ akũ.
Bɛláabuki binu tɔwɛ̃ tɛsankuo, tifluti mɔ kugbulɛɛ tido.
Litsedi kĩ ladã ndɛ mpo kĩ bɛkɔa ahuhɔɛ bɛkɛna deĩ nɛ awã nɛ lɛgãkpo a anɛ kamɛ.
Bɔmɔ́ ye lisibii kĩ lide nɛ suwa kadekɔ̃, ade bɔya kĩ bɔ́asum ye a.
Ɛkɔa koe ɛkpa ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a kĩ bɛsɛ̃ koe lɛmɛ bɛkpa be.
Kĩ ɔnɔkɔɛ̃ kĩĩ nu Yesu nkã a, edo Yudafɔ banɔkɔɛ̃ badi kĩ bɛnaabi ye ɛyaatsa ye ɔsumunɛ a.
Kitonɛkĩ ntɛ bide lɛtsã nɛ ɔnɔkɔali kamɛ ĩye nɛ fɔvã kama osi akũ malo ni, kĩ Kristo akũ bide lɛtsã a sũ ni, kawɔlɛ de yĩ.
Bɛkpã Yesu Bɛnamɛna Pilato Sɛkɛ̃.
Ade bakɛna be tɛtadiɛ wulaa atɔ tɛsa, tɛvanɛ mɔ mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ gɛlɛɛlɛgɛlɛɛlɛ a!
Ke liti a, ode fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ mɔ kɔbɛ̃ odi bɔɛ de kĩ lɔpɔnɛ lububu ndɛ kɔwɔlɛ ade ɛta edo nɛ mpo kamɛ, ɛlɛ kĩ.
Maátsɛlɛ mi fukĩĩ kĩ mado mi kɔnyɔã, mbom makɔa foe ndɛ mi ndɛ yĩ babi kĩ mawɛ be kalɛ aye.
Nwaɛ̃ amɛ, ndɛ bati kĩ bɛtɛ boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo, kĩ ɛnyɛ kukũkpalɛ Ɔlate a bido sũ ni, mitadã bati anɛ nɛ mi fɔtsa kakɛna kamɛ.
Babɔa lɛgbã kĩ, “Bɛkpa boe osi kĩ bɔkɛna lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa.
Bɔláayɛla lɛtsama ntɛ bɔtánya ade ayea bɔláana nfasɔ adima ntɛ bɔnya lɛmɛ a.
Nɛ foesũ bisui onukpɛ̃ bɛbɔa mpaɛ, bite awɛ nɛ be akũ ade bɛnyɛ be osi a.
Paulo mɔ Sila tsã bito Amfipoli mɔ Apolonia bɛyawo Tesalonika, awã kĩ Yudafɔ katsɛnakɔ̃ kadi na.
Ntɛ nkɔa yĩ akũ fɔtsa flee nte ahiãfɔ, ĩye ntɛ nkɔa yĩ akũ mbɔa afɔliɛ kĩ bipila mɔ ntɛ bati kawɛ lɛláa yĩ kamɛ ni, nlá nfasɔ adima.
Nɛ foesũ mibinya mi tɔkpa kamɛ mitsa mi akũ akũ, mibɔa mpaɛ mikpa akũ, ayekĩ míana kasaɛ.
Otsole a bi Yesu kĩ, “Ɔnɔkɔɛ̃, kpa yĩ mui a na badi ayekĩ ɔmɔado lɛláabuki ɛkɔ yĩ da, ĩye mbuki ĩya nɛ awĩ kĩ maanu mui.
Yesu kĩĩ nyɛ be mɔ boe flee Ɔlate.
Lɛmɛ kĩ bɔmɔ sodzafɔ buwo awã a, nnu kĩ Romani yanɛ sũ ni, nfɔ̃ sodzafɔ a tɛ ye nɛ be awɛ.
Ade awã mɔ Abonsam sɔ ye ɛdã fuwi tɛna flee a.
Lɛmɛ nɛ boe katsɛna kamɛ ni, mawɛ kĩ malɛ fɔlɛtsa sukuloo kĩ bati aanu foe kayɔ bɛkɔa bɛkɔlɛ fɔtsa, kɛba kĩ maalɛ fɔlɛtsa pii nɛ tide bɛbã kamɛ.
Bati a kĩ bɛtɛ Kristo bido fɔmɔ biku a aanya lɔtɔ biyidza.
Yesu na nɛ Betania ɔmatɔ kamɛ nɛ Simon kĩ ɛsɔ tɔ̃ fɔsɔ ngbã a awã.
Ovoli kĩĩ kamɛ fɔlɛtsa nyɛ Yesu Kristo kanyɛ katsa a kĩ Baguma kpa ye, kĩ ɛnyɛ ɛtsa ye basumunɛ nɛ fɔtsa a kĩ kɛnɛ kĩ fɔya nɛ lɔkɔ lukũ kamɛ a akũ.
Odima lɛláatɛ ye nɛ yĩ awɛ, mbom yĩ mɔawɛ lɛkɔa ye nkpa.
Lɛmɛ ntɛ fu mɔ tuwĩ kpa mɛ nɛ te akũ ni, nfasɔ adima lɛláa te akũ.
Ntɛ mipi fɔlɛtsa a kĩ minu a midomɔ akũ ni, míapuli mina nɛ ɔmɔa kakɛna kamɛ mɔ Obi a mɔ Ɔlɛga a.
Yesu Mɔ Ye Fɔtsa Bakɔlɛnɛ a Se Asɔli Kɔla Ɔgɔlɛ.
Bati kĩĩ flee katsɛna lɔkɔ nyɛ lɔkɔ mɔ kakɔna mɔa, kabɔa mpaɛ kakpa Baguma.
Nláabuki nvɛ mi kĩ basumunɛ, kitonɛkĩ ɔsumunɛ linyína lɛtsa a kĩ ye ɔlate akɛna.
Ade foesũ mabi mi kĩ baakɔa tɔkpa nyɛ tɔkpa mɔ fubusuotsa fudi nyɛ fudi kĩ bati alɛ a bite be, lɛmɛ odi nyɛ odi kĩ yaalɛ fubusuotsa nɛ Hũhũ Kpalɛwa a kɔ̃ akũ ni, bɛláakɔa bite ye.
Nwaɛ̃ amɛ kĩ maátunɔ kalɛ, mite anɛ nɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ akũ!
Ntɛ lɔkɔ a wo ɔtɔ a, Baguma aakpa mi fɔlɛtsa a kĩ míalɛ a, kitonɛkĩ nnɛ́ mi aalɛ kɔdzɛla, mbom mi Ɔlɛga Hũhũ a aalɛ kɔdzɛla ɛtsãmɛna mi akũ.
Lɛmɛ ɛlɛ eyi kĩ yaakɔa tite a na ɛkpa ye tɛnya ye mɔ ye babi mɔ bawa tide, titɔ kĩ nɛ lɔkɔ a na kamɛ malo ɛtáma obi odima!
Oti a kĩ ɛkɛna ɔmɔa mɔ yĩ, mɔ yĩ malo nkɛna ɔmɔa mɔ ye ni, ade ye aawũ babi pii, kitonɛkĩ ntɛ nláa mi kamɛ ni, miláapuli mikɛna lɛtsama.
Ntɛ mi kamɛ odi kɔna kĩ ɛnyɛ Baguma onukpɛ̃ ɔnyɛnɛ, ĩye edeĩ hũhũ kamɛ futetsa ni, enyi kĩ lɛtsa a kĩ ntsɛlɛ mamɛna mi a nyɛ boe Ɔlate mbla kĩ ɛkpa.
Bike mi malo mite nɛ seebi sɛyɔde a kĩ fɔtɔ banyanɛ mɔ Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ a ke a akũ, ade Kristo Yesu mɔawɛ nyɛ́ kɔla a akũ de titiliwu a.
Titɔ kĩ bati alɛ kĩ baviɔ̃ deĩ nɛ ode mɔ tite akũ, kĩ baviɔ̃ kumɛkumɛ kĩĩ mɔ be balate deĩ malo ni, boe kɔ̃ bunyina kĩ Baguma mɔapɛ deĩ.

“Nda, mawɛ kĩ bati a kĩ ɔkɔa ɔkpa yĩ a bɛna nɛ awã kĩ ndeĩ a, ayekĩ baamɔ yĩ kukũkpalɛ a kĩ ɔkpa yĩ a, kitonɛkĩ ɔwɛ yĩ kalɛ fɔmɔ biyi katinya kayɔ.
Yesu kpa ye mbuayɛ kĩ, “Oowo, nnɛ́ titi evũkɔnɔ, mbom aduesɔũ titi evũkɔnɔ.
Kayade nyɛ Salem lɛgã kĩ fɔatsa kĩ Lukudɔ Lɛgã.
Fɔtsɛ̃ foe akũ sũ ɛtápuli ɛkɛna awãwã fɔtsa pii nɛ awã, kɛba kĩ ete awɛ nɛ basɔnɛ badi akũ, ade be fɔsɔ a dɔ be a.
Yohanes tásĩ be mbuayɛ kakpa, mbom ɛkpalɛ fɔlɛtsa kamɛ yededeede ɛlɛ kĩ, “Nnɛ́ yĩ nyɛ Kristo a.
Ade ayea Kristo lɛmɛ kɔa ye akũ ɛbɔa afɔliɛ deedimɔapɛ, ɛnyɛ bati pii tɔkpa a ɛnamɛna a.
Finyaakĩĩ, O boe Ɔlate, dã ɔhau a kĩ ye kamɛ bido boe, lɔkɔa kado boe nɔ adzuma bakɛnanɛ a ɔwɔlɛ, ayekĩ bɔ́apuli bɔlɛ nɔ kalɛ wĩ a nɛ katavila kamɛ.

Kɔdɛ a kĩ bɔakpa mi a táto bati kakɛ, adzuni kpa ĩye tɛdake tisi kamɛ, mbom bubi mi kalɛ lɔkɔ nyɛ lɔkɔ ndɛ ayekĩ Baguma wɛ kĩ bɔlɛ, kitonɛkĩ ye mɔawɛ a ɛsɔ boe ɛdã, ɛmɔ́ kĩ bɔfɛta bɔkpa ye Kalɛ Wĩ a kalɛ.
Baguma hihiɛ kĩ otidziwa eku deedimɔapɛ, ade nɛ wuda liti a, yaadzɛmɔ ye.
Ɛya nɛ ye mɔawɛ bati sɛkɛ̃, lɛmɛ ye bati a tátɛ ye.
Minyina pefee kĩ tɔkpa bakɛnanɛ tɔkpa a na odu lɛláana kanyakɔ̃ nɛ Baguma lɛgãkanyakɔ̃ a kamɛ.
Mi mɔawɛ mikɔna midã ntɛ fɔnɛnɛ kĩ otsole abɔa mpaɛ ɛkpa Baguma nɛ kanade, kĩ ɛtásui duku nɛ lɔlɔ.
“Midã kadã wĩ, ayekĩ miláasupa babisɛ̃ kĩĩ kamɛ odima.
Ade fukĩĩ sũ Baguma do yĩ ndɛ fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ mɔ fɔtsa ɔtsanɛ nɛ bikĩ bɛnyɛ́ Yudafɔ sɛkɛ̃ kĩ nde lɛtsã nɛ katɛkado mɔ ɔnɔkɔali kalɛ a akũ.
Asa ma Yosafat, Yosafat ma Yoram, Yoram ma Uziya.
Fɔmɔ Baguma bɔɛ ye bɛnamɛna ode a, Yesu tsã Hũhũ Kpalɛwa kɔbɛ̃ akũ ɛtsa ye fɔtɔ banyanɛ a kĩ ɛpau a fɔtsa.
Make Ewodia mɔ Sinteke aduli kĩ bɛbɔa mbɔdi binu akũ kayɔ ndɛ bawaɛ̃tsole aye nɛ boe Ɔlate dĩ akũ.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛwɛ kĩ yapili ye nkpã ni, yaayɛla ye, lɛmɛ odi nyɛ odi kĩ yaayɛla ye nkpã nɛ yĩ sũ ni, yaana nkpã kĩ ɛlá kawũna a.
Kĩ bɔkla akũ buyua a, budzi ɔkɔlɔ bɔtsã kpĩĩ bunyina bɔnaa Kos.

Ntɛ mitsɛna ni, maana nɛ mi kamɛ nɛ hũhũ kamɛ nɛ boe Ɔlate Yesu kɔbɛ̃ a kĩ kɔana nɛ boe kamɛ a sũ, mikɔa oti a mido nɛ Abonsam awɛ lɔkɔa ɛwɔla ye sukɛna a, ayekĩ ye hũhũ a aapuli ɛna katɛ nɛ boe Ɔlate Luwi a akũ.
Miakpa Baguma tuwĩ kĩ bakɔa kado funitsã ɔlɛ̃ te kamɛ kasɛ̃ katsu kawuade a pɛpɛɛpɛ, lɛmɛ mifɔnɛ mbla fɔtsa katsa sĩwa, kĩ fɔnyɛ fɔlɛtsa kadzɛ nɛ osi kpĩĩ, kɔnyakamɔ mɔ ɔnɔkɔali kadi awɛ.
Ɛnyɛ babumɛnanɛ evũkɔnɔ a kĩ bɛpau nɛ Yerusalem a kamɛ ɔmɔa.
Lutubu lidi deĩ nɛ Yerusalem kakɔ a kĩ bavɛ Baveli Onyukpɛ̃ a ɔwɛ̃, kĩ bavɛ nɛ Hebri tide kamɛ kĩ Betesda.
Bideĩ anɛ kĩ yamɔ batsole adɔpaafɔ, ade anɛ a kakɔa kakɛna tɔkpa láplo be a.
Tafɔ̃ oti odima lɛdã nɔ ndɛ obisɛ̃ nɛ ayekĩ ɔnyɛ opopo sũ.
Ntɛ bɛsã te lɔmɔ a, banɔkɔɛ̃ tɛya-ana a atsa anɛ nɛ tite nɛ oti a kĩ edzi nɛ lɛgãkpo akũ a anɛ kamɛ, kasum ye a kĩ edzi nkpã daa a.
Ntɛ kawɔlɛ de mi kamɛ odi ni, ɛsã tɔnɔ emu Baguma.
Nnɛ́ be odi bade bɛmɔ́, mbom mɔ bati a kĩ bɛkɔ nɛ tite akũ a.
Bɛvɛlɛ Babilonia sɔtɔ, kitonɛkĩ ye kamɛ bɛmɔ́ Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ mɔ Baguma bade a babɔanɛ.
Baguma mbla akũ kakɛna lɛlá ɔsĩ ɛkpa boe, kitonɛkĩ odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛnyɛ Baguma obi anya katinya kamɛ akũ.
Foesũ Kristo yade lɛtsã nɛ Kalɛ Wĩ a lukudɔ akũ ɛkpa bati flee, bikĩ bɛnyɛ́ Yudafɔ a kĩ bɛna mɔ lugo nɛ Baguma sɛkɛ̃ a, mɔ Yudafɔ a kĩ bifuã Baguma a.
Lɛmɛ bati badi muniki nɛ fɔtsa kĩĩ liti, foesũ bɛyɛla osi wĩ a, ade bɛkɔa be lɔkɔ bɛkpa fɔlɛtsa kavɛlɛ mɔ fɔkɔasiatsa kalɛ a.
” Ade bibuki bɛtsɛlɛ nɛ Katsɛlɛ Kpalɛwa kamɛ kĩ, “Boe Ɔlate nyina kĩ, bikĩ binyina kadi a be adzuni nyɛ fɔtsa pupulidza.
Bɔawɔ̃na mi, boe bawaɛ̃ kĩ minyɛ́ Yudafɔ a kĩ mito Antiokia, Siria mɔ Kilikia.
Lɛgã a na kalɔkpa paa, foesũ edo ye sodzafɔ bɛnakɔ awudifɔ a, bipila be ɔmatɔ a lɛmɛ.
’ Ntɛ tɔtɔ a kamɛ bati a tɛ mi mɔ kawɔlɛ ni, mifɔ̃ mi lukudɔ kawɔ̃na a kɛkahɔ nɛ be akũ.
Nɛ fukĩĩ sũ, kito anɛ kĩ nnu kĩ mitɛ boe Ɔlate Yesu mido, miawɛ Baguma bati a flee kalɛ a, ntáfɔ̃ Baguma kɔlɛ kanyɛ nɛ mi lɔlɔ.
Kanɛ kɛnɛ kĩ ayɔlɔhɔ api mi lɔkɔa minyɛ oti a kĩ ɛkɛna fɔtsa kpa kĩĩ odu a nɛ mi asɔli katsu a kamɛ.
Kĩ sodza ɔnɔkɔɛ̃ a vila kĩ baavɛlɛ ye bɛpããpãã sũ ni, ebi ye sodzafɔ a kĩ bɛka bɛnaatɛ ye bɛnaado nɛ kɔla.
Ade ayea Marko, mɔ Aristarko, mɔ Dema, mɔ Luka, yĩ bakɔba kĩ babumɔ yĩ adzuma kĩĩ kakɛna a, awɔ̃na nɔ.
ade yaakɛna sɛmɛ kalɛ ɛkpa bikĩ bɛlá kabumɛna a.
Kĩ bɛtsɛna a, ebi be kĩ, “Nwaɛ̃ amɛ, bipi yĩ nɛ Yerusalem bɛkɔa bɛma Roma abãã kĩ ɛdzɛmɔ yĩ, titɔ kĩ ntáfum odima, ĩye nfum boe bawanyɔ amaniɛ adima malo.
Mimɔ́ ayekĩ bupi boe akũ nɛ mi kamɛ kĩ fɔnya kabumɛna fɔkpa mi.
Baguma aawɔla be ndɛ ayekĩ batidziwa awɔla tuwĩ kamɛ bayaɛ.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ yaáwɛ oti kalɛ ni, ɛkahɔ nɛ wuda kamɛ.
Bɛma ye ndɛ otidziwa aye, ade ɛya nɛ oti kutidu kamɛ a.
” Ade eyo awɛ ɛtsa ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a ɛlɛ kĩ, “Midã, ade mma mɔ nwaɛ̃ amɛ nɛ awĩ a!
Lɛtsa a kĩ Yesu kɛna a, kɛna bati kɔdabu a flee a saa, ade bivia kĩ, “Mbɔɛɛ nnɛ́ Dawid Obi a nɛ awĩ a?
Otsole a bi ye kĩ, “Ɔnɔkɔɛ̃, ɔnɛ́ɛ bokiti kĩ bakɔa kanu mui, ade lɔwɔkɛ a lɛmɛ dzũ a.
‘Maakɔa nhila kpalɛwa a kĩ nlɛ ĩyi nkpa Dawid a nkpa nɔ.
Kalɛ a na nɛ katinya kamɛ, lɛmɛ titɔ kĩ Baguma bɔa katinya ɛtsãmɛna ye akũ malo ni, batidziwa támɔ ye biyi ɔsũ.
Nikodemo via ye kĩ, “Nde baapuli bibuki bɛma oti kĩ ebo anɛ?
Baguma hila bati a kĩ bakɛna nɛ ovoli kĩĩ kamɛ fɔlɛtsa a kĩ bɛlɛ biyi a akũ!
Nnɛ́ kɔbɛ̃ ado ye kĩ ɛnya funitsã kĩ bɛkɔa bɛbɔa afɔliɛ bɛkpa baviɔ̃?
Yabi be kĩ bɛtate ɔgɔlɛ bɛkpa Romafɔ Lɛgãnɔkɔɛ̃.
” Lɛmɛ odima lɛláa nɛ ode, nɛ tite akũ, ĩye nɛ tite ɔda kĩ yaapuli ebinya ovoli a, ĩye ɛdã ye kamɛ.
Nɛ ɛkwansieda luwi lɛtɔnyade akũ a, bɔtsɛna kĩ bɔa nya boe Ɔlate funitsã a.
Kĩ Yesu lɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ eyua a, ebuki ɛlɛ kĩ, “Boe ɔkɔba Lazaro wa tida, lɛmɛ maanaadzɛla ye.
Ɛtsa fɔtsa nɛ Yudafɔ fɔtsɛnakɔ̃ a, ade odi nyɛ odi mu ye fɔtsa katsa a.
Kɛnɛ kĩ Kristo ɛnya lɛgã kɛnawo kĩ Baguma nya bakesĩnɛ flee akũ, ɛkɔa ye abɔa ete nɛ be akũ.
Foesũ mifɔ̃ yĩ ɔdɔ a ɛna nkɔsu nɛ mi kamɛ lɔmɔ.
Ɔnɔkpa a nyɛ otsole odi kĩ ɛnyɛ okunawa obinyole mɔapɛ, ade ke ɔmatɔ a kamɛ bati pii lɛmɛ tomɔ okunawa a.
Yesu dzakũ nɛ awã ɛnaa kayite a kĩ kifuã Tiro mɔ Sidon tɛmatɔ kpale a kamɛ.
Ɛlɛ kĩ, “Maahila nɔ ade maakpa nɔ babi mɔ bawa beblebee lɛmɛ a.
Ndɛ ayekĩ bɔtɛ budo kĩ boe a flee bɔna katɛ fɔtsã boe Ɔlate Yesu kɔnyakamɔ kamɛ a, ade ayea be malo bɛna katɛ a.
Lɛmɛ lɛkpati katsua nyɛ sukɛna katsua kɛkɛ, kĩ otidziwa lɛkɔa awɛ ɛkɛna foe.
Ntɛ fɔ́asĩ kĩ yĩ malo nnaa ni, bɔmɔ be bɔ́atsã kɔbɔa mɔa.
Bitomɛna mbla kumɛkumɛ lɛmɛ kĩ bibo anɛ bɛyamɔ a, ndɛ kuyei, fɔtɔtsa mɔ fugumi kavɔlɛ.
Farisifɔ a nu kĩ Yesu kawɔla bati mui, kĩ ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a kapɔ kaba Yohanes bade.
Foesũ nnɛ́ batidziwa kadikanyi kĩ batsa bɔnɛɛ bɔalɛ kalɛ, mbom bɔnɛɛ fɔlɛtsa a kĩ Hũhũ a tsa boe a bɔkɔa bɔanyɛ hũhũ kamɛ ɔnɔkɔali fɔtsa a katsa bikĩ Hũhũ deĩ nɛ be kamɛ a.
Odenyinawi a, Yesu dzakũ nɛ ɔmatɔ a kamɛ ɛnaa kakɔ dĩĩ kadi, ade bati a do ye kawɛ awɛ a.
Ovoli kĩĩ to yĩ, Paulo, mɔ Timoteo kĩ bɔnyɛ Kristo Yesu basumunɛ sɛkɛ̃.
Lɛmɛ bɛmɔ́ foe mɔ lugo, bɛtɛ foe mɔ kawɔlɛ ade bitunɔ nɛ foe akũ kĩ banɔvɔɛ̃ mɔ basitsãnɛ banɛ nɛ tite kĩĩ akũ a.
Ade Hũhũ Kpalɛwa tɛ be kamɛ flee, ade bido kɔdzɛla kalɛ awɛ nɛ tide futefute kamɛ, ndɛ ayekĩ Hũhũ a kpa be a.
“Ade aye baabɔɛ Babilonia ɔmatɔ kpale a bibo mɔ fɔkɔ.
Lɛmɛ Kristo ya kɔkɔɛ ndɛ Ɔsɔfɔnɔkɔɛ̃ Flee ɛkpa fɔtsa wĩ a kĩ fɔya kɔkɔɛ a.
Yĩ babi, nlamɛna fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ katsɛlɛ kamɛna mi ayekĩ miláakɛna tɔkpa.
Kutse kĩĩ yapɔ kɔkɛna futse baũ a kamɛ kɔmɔa nɛ kɔba kamɛ.
Ntɛ nɔ kɔlɛkanyɛ mpaɛbɔ a nɛnɛ malo ni, fɔtábumɛna oti bɛbã nɛ osi odima akũ.
Ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a nake ye aduli bɛlɛ kĩ, “Blɔmɛna ye ɛdzakũ, kitonɛkĩ etomɔ boe mɔ fɔwɔla!
Ade ye nyɛ oti a kĩ yalɛ kĩ nnɛ́ Yesu nyɛ Kristo a.
Mabi mi nɛ ɔnɔkɔali kamɛ kĩ sɔtɔ kavɛlɛ nɛ wuda kĩĩ flee akũ aaya nɛ mi nviã babi akũ!
Maado yĩ adansifɔ nviã kĩ bidzi nɛ tikpekpe tilima kamɛ, bɛyaade lɛtsã nɛ Baguma fɔlɛtsa akũ nɛ fuwi apim mɔa mɔ ɔha nviã mɔ aduesia kamɛ.
Ɛnya lɔtɔ ɛtsɛla yĩ sukɛna kugua kĩ yamanɛ yĩ eyi ɛkpa yĩ kabila.
Adansiɛ kadi a nyɛ kĩ, Baguma kpa boe nkpã kĩ ɛlá kawũna a, ade nkpã kĩĩ lɛmɛ deĩ nɛ ye Obi kamɛ a.
Fɔtsa kĩĩ mɛna Baguma fɔlɛtsa a, foesũ fɔáwũ babi.
Midzi nkpã ndɛ bati kĩ bidzi be akũ akũ aye, lɛmɛ mitakɔa akũ akũ kadzi a mikɛna ndɛ tɔkpa kakɛna osi kana, mbom midzi nkpã ndɛ Baguma basate aye.
Edeĩ bayitsɔ̃ ɛna kĩ bidzí fɔnyɔ, ade bɛnyɛ Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ lɛmɛ a.
Ɛnɛɛ sika ngbã kɔɔpu kĩ eyi mɔ efĩĩ mɔ kɔwɛ̃ fɔtsa a kĩ ɛna etomɛna ye adɔpaa kabɔa kamɛ a nɛ awɛ.
Kitonɛkĩ Baguma lɛ nɛ Katsɛlɛ Kpalɛwa a lɛ kĩ, “Minya bati kpalɛwa, kitonɛkĩ oti kpalɛwa manɛ.
Kɛnɛ Kĩ Batɛ Badonɛ Bɛlɔla Be Mɔawɛ Kayite.
-Nɛ foesũ bɔtsa fɔlɔ buke otse kĩ bɔado batɔ nviã nɛ mi sɛkɛ̃.
Kɛnɛ kĩ miakɛna lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa nɛ de osi akũ mɔ obu kamɛ.
Nɛ foesũ nkɔa kudulike makpa nɔ nɛ Onesimo lɔlɔ.
Mifɔ̃ bɔbɔɛ foe kĩ osikani sua lima wĩ akũ, edo sika lipetia, ɛya nɛ mi katsɛnakɔ̃, ade ohiãni odi lɛmɛ do tɛtadiɛ kpeliwa ɛya nɛ awã a.
Bɔtɛ budo kĩ budeĩ nɛ Baguma kamɛ, ade ye malo edeĩ nɛ boe kamɛ a, kitonɛkĩ ɛkɔa ye mɔawɛ Hũhũ ɛkpa boe.
Lɛmɛ Baguma aadzɛla odi nyɛ odi nɛ ye nhihiɛ a kĩ ɛkɛna eyi akũ.
Mbom be fɔtsakɛlawa fɔnya fɔtsa wĩ ndɛ batsole kĩ bɛkɔa be akũ bɛkpa Baguma.
Kĩ bɛka ɔtɔ a baya a, Yesu si be mbla kĩ, “Mitabi odima lɛtsa a kĩ bɛnyɛ bɛtsa mi nɛ awĩ a, kɛnaawo kĩ bɛdzɛla Otidziwa Obi a bitomɛna kanɔkpa.
Kɛtánɛ kĩ bɔasɔ boe Ɔlate bɔdã ndɛ ayekĩ be kamɛ badi kɛna a, nɛ foesũ bɔɛ dɔ̃ be biku.
Manyɛ Baguma kɔlɛ kĩ ntákɛna mi kamɛ odima mui kawɔla amaniɛ kɛba Krispo mɔ Gayo odi pɛ.
Luwi a lɛnyɛ, ɛya nɛ Yesu sɛkɛ̃ ɛyabi ye kĩ, “Fɔtsa Ɔtsanɛ, bunyina kĩ Baguma sɛkɛ̃ oto ɔya, kitonɛkĩ odima lɛláapuli ɛkɛna nsɛntsɛlɛni a kĩ akɛna a, ntɛ Baguma lítomɔ ye.
Ade ye nyɛ ɔnɔkɔali Baguma mɔ nkpã kĩ ɛlá kawũna a.
Nɛ Kawɛya Luwi bɛbã akũ ni, Yesu naa Yudafɔ katsɛnakɔ̃ a ɛnaatsa fɔtsa.
Nɔ nyɛ Baguma Oti Kpalɛwa Kĩ Bido a!
Yesu yo awɛ ɛta ye ade ebi ye kĩ, “Mawɛ lɔmɔ.
Tihiko, boe ɔwaɛ̃ kĩ bɔátunɔ kalɛ, aayabi mi yĩ akũ fɔlɛtsa flee.
Nɛ kĩ bati a flee kamu Baguma nɛ lɛtsa a kĩ lɛya a akũ sũ ni, bɛtápuli bɛna osi a kĩ ye akũ baatsã bɛvɛlɛ be sɔtɔ.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ yalɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩ fɔtáfɛta nɛ ye ɔwaɛ̃ okristoni akũ, ĩye yadzɛmɔ ɔwaɛ̃ ni, yalɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩ fɔtáfɛta nɛ mbla a akũ, ade yadzɛ mɔ mbla a.
Baakɛna nɔ nɛ kayɔ flee ɔnaawo kanɔkpade!
ade ɔkɔa nɔ kanɔkɔnɛ kadã ɔkɛ katinya kamɛ bati flee a.
Yesu nɛ́ nɛ ɔkɔlɔ a kamɛ, ade kĩ ɛmɔ bati kɔdabu a, be akũ kɔ ye kɔnya, ade ɛtsa be kamɛ basɔnɛ a.
Lɛmɛ baánu be mɔawɛ fɔlɛtsa a kĩ balɛ, ĩye fukĩ bɛtɛ bido mɔ ɔsĩ mɔ ɔsĩ a kayɔ malo.
Yesu nyi lɛtsa a kĩ bɛkakɔna a, foesũ ebi be kĩ, “Ɔmaĩ odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛsɛ̃ ye akũ nɛ kutsu kutsu kamɛ, mɔ tɛdzɛ deĩ nɛ ye kamɛ ni, ɛláadzi gɛlɛɛlɛ.
Lɛmɛ kĩ ɔhaĩ kamɛ bati bɔanɛ sũ ni, mifɔ̃ bɔkɔa boe katɛkado mɔ ɔdɔ bɔkɛna ɔwɔlɛ libĩĩ katɛ sɔbɔtsaɛ, mɔ boe kɔnɛte nɛ boe nkpã akũ bɔkɛna sɔbɔtsaɛ lɔbɔɛ.
Nɛ kĩ Paulo aadzakũ ntɛ kade nyina sũ ni, ɛlɛ kɔdzɛla flee kɛnawo lɛnyɛ kayite.
Bɛtsɛlɛ mbusuo buĩ kĩ basupa Baguma bite nɛ ɔyaɛ a akũ flee, ade edeĩ fɔlɔ evũkɔnɔ mɔ tɛlɛ ewua a.
Owi tábuna mɔ banyole badi kĩ bɛkɔlɛ fɔtsa nɛ fusibii kadã akũ to suwa kadekɔ̃ bɛya nɛ Yerusalem, ade bɛyavia kĩ, “Ndia bɛma obisɛ̃ a kĩ yaanya Yudafɔ lɛgã a?
Banyole batɛ badonɛ a kĩ bɛtɛ bido a pɔ biwo ndɛ mpim elo.
Adeke kĩ bibi yĩ kĩ bɛlamɔ nhihiɛ kakɛna kĩ baakɔ ye sũ ni, nkɔna kĩ makɔa ye mma nɔ.
Nɛ fuwi kĩĩ kamɛ a, batɛ badonɛ a flee kɛna ɔmɔa nɛ be fɔkɛnatsa mɔ adzuni kamɛ.
Kitonɛkĩ ntɛ fɔnyɛ Baguma kawɛ ni, fɔnɛnɛ kĩ miamɔ lubo ndɛ tuwĩ bakɛnanɛ, kɛba kĩ míamɔ lubo ndɛ tɔkpa bakɛnanɛ.
Ke liti a, bɛta wuda mɔ kanɔkpade biwula nɛ fi lutubu baũ a kamɛ.
Mi botaɛ fɔnya kĩ miadzi nkpã nɛ akũ kadɔla kamɛ, odi nyɛ odi ɛdã ye adzuma.
Luwi daa kĩ yawa kayidza, ade babi a amɛ kabo anɛ.
Mabɔa mpaɛ kĩ ɔmɔa a kĩ bɔakɛna ndɛ batɛ badonɛ aye a ɛna ɔsĩ ebu, ayekĩ bɔ́apuli bunu fɔtsa wĩ flee a kĩ fudeĩ nɛ ɔmɔa kakɛna mɔ Kristo kayɔ a dzununuunu.
Ɛnɛɛ fusibii evũkɔnɔ nɛ ye sɔmɔna awɛ, ade atugbe mɔ ɔbɔ̃ lɛmɛ nɛ eto ye onukpɛ̃ kamɛ a, ade anɛ kamɛ amɔanɛ ndɛ suwa ketee aye a.
Nɔ mɔawɛ onukpɛ̃ kamɛ fɔlɛtsa baakɔa bɛdzɛmɔ nɔ bɛkpa nɔ ɔtɔbɛ ĩye bɛkɔ nɔ kɔtɔ.
Petro bi ye kĩ, “Owoo, ɔláavɔlɛ yĩ abɔa da.
Lɛmɛ boe kɔ̃ ni, boe ɔtɔ nyɛ ode, ade budzi bɔadã boe Ɔtɛnɛ kĩ ɛnyɛ boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo anɛ kĩ eto ode ɛya a.
” Atenefɔ mɔ banɔvɔɛ̃ a kĩ bideĩ nɛ awã awɛ be lɔkɔ flee kakpa fɔlɛtsa vɔɛ̃ katse mɔ foe akũ kɔlɔmɛna.
Mafɔ̃ fukpeni awo yĩ akũ ayekĩ yĩ sukɛna aapuli sɛdza sɛkpa lubo kamɔ.
Ndɛ ayekĩ minu kĩ Kristo okesĩnɛ a aaya a, finyaakĩĩ malo Kristo bakesĩnɛ pii nɛ́ kɔkɔɛ, nɛ foesũ bunyina kĩ katinya kawũna a fuã.
Kito katinya kayɔkayi a, onyole mɔ otsole Baguma kɛna.
Nnɛ́ lɛtsa kĩ lawo nɛ oti onukpɛ̃ kamɛ a ado ye efĩĩ, mbom lɛtsa a kĩ lanɛ kato ye onukpɛ̃ kamɛ a, ado ye efĩĩ.
Bɔmɔ́ Kipro tite a nɛ lɔtɔ, ade bɔtsã te kayɔ kayɔ a bɔnaduma nɛ Tiro, nɛ Siria tite akũ, awã kĩ baanyɛ fɔtsa flee a kĩ ɔkɔlɔ a nɔnɛ a.
Yakɛna foe titiliwu nɛ bati a kĩ bitomɔ sukɛna fɔwɛtsa kpa kĩ fɔakɔ odo liti, kĩ foesũ baábu Baguma otumi kĩ yanya be akũ a kado nɛ lɛtsama kamɛ.
Lɛmɛ mawɛ kĩ minyi kĩ Kristo nyɛ lɔlɔ ɛkpa odi nyɛ odi.
Kĩ mmɔ́ ye a, nnɛ́ ntɔ nɛ ye abɔa kamɛ ndɛ oti kĩ eku, ade ɛkɔa ye sɔmɔna awɛ ete nɛ yĩ akũ ɛlɛ kĩ, “Tavila!
Lɛmɛ ndɛ ayekĩ Katsɛlɛ Kpalɛwa a lɛ kĩ, “Ntɛ odi awɛ epia ni, kɛnɛ kĩ epia nɛ lɛtsa a kĩ boe Ɔlate kɛna a akũ.
Onyole nyɛ onyole enyi ɔtsɔ̃ kapi wĩ nɛ kukũkpalɛ mɔ obu kamɛ, ɛtatomɔ sukɛna fɔwɛtsa ɔmɛnɛ liti ndɛ bikĩ binyína Baguma aye.
Lɛmɛ ntɛ bɔlɛ kĩ bɔtákɛna tɔkpa ni, bute Baguma fɔvã, ade ke ye kalɛ a lɛmɛ lɛláa boe kamɛ a.
Foesũ luwi a na lɛtayaafuta mi ndɛ oyekpanɛ aye, kitonɛkĩ mi flee minyɛ ɔhaĩ bati.
Lɛmɛ boe kɔ̃ Kristo kakɔna a deĩ nɛ boe kamɛ.
Kitonɛkĩ bɔbɔɛ foe kĩ yĩ obi kĩĩ ku lɛmɛ finyaakĩĩ edzi nkpã.
” Kitonɛkĩ nnɛ́ oti a kĩ yamu ye mɔawɛ akũ a nyɛ oti wĩ, mbom oti a kĩ boe Ɔlate amu nyɛ oti wĩ.
Nɛ foesũ eke otse kĩ yabuki ɛdani ɛtsã Makedonia kamɛ a.
Bati ɛlalɛ kĩĩ odi nyɛ Yudafɔ kĩ bɛdani Kristofɔ bakɛna mɔ yĩ adzuma a bɔkpa Baguma lɛgãkanyakɔ̃ a.
Ntɛ kanyi binyi ke kufɛ bɛtábɔa boe Ɔlate kpalɛwa a nɛ asendua akũ.
” Fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ sũ Herodes wɛ kĩ yakɔ Yohanes, lɛmɛ evila Yudafɔ a kitonɛkĩ babu ye ndɛ Baguma onukpɛ̃ ɔnyɛnɛ aye.
Bɛkpa oti a kĩ edzi nɛ ye akũ a kɔbɛ̃ kĩ ɛnyɛ lukudɔ nɛ tite akũ, lɔkɔa bati bɛkɔ be akũ akũ.
Fuwi ɛlalɛ liti a, Paulo vɛ Yudafɔ banɔkɔɛ̃ a kĩ bideĩ nɛ awã a ɛkpɔta.
Bɔado ɔpɔnkɔ sɔbɔtsaɛ nɛ onukpɛ̃ kamɛ kĩ ɛkɛna nɛ boe kawɛ akũ, kapuli kafɔ̃ yanaa awã kĩ bɔawɛ a.
Ntɛ bati liti katomɛna yawo nɛ kalɛ kĩĩ akũ pɛ, baamuniki nɛ ke liti.
Ɛwɛ kĩ yadani ɔnɔkɔɛ̃ a adzuni nɛ lɛtsa a kĩ Saulo mɔ Barnaba lɛ a akũ.
Ɔmɔa dzi nɛ ye lɔlɔ nyangɛ, ɔbɛbã dzi nɛ ye abɔa kayɔ.
Ade Yesu do be kamɛ bati nviã, mɔ ɔlɛdo kĩ, “Minaa ɔmatɔ a kamɛ, oti odi kĩ ɛnɔnɛ kugumi aatsɛlamɔ mi.
Hũhũ Kpalɛwa a lɛfɔ̃ Dawid lɛ eyi kĩ.
Ade ayea ntɛ nɔ linebi aafɔ̃ ɔkɛna tɔkpa ni, bɔlɛ de kanyɛ kata kamuni!
Kĩ bɛmɔna ye lubo a, ɛtáhũnahũna odima, mbom ɛkɔa anɛ ete nɛ Baguma a kĩ yadzɛ fɔlɛtsa nɛ osi kpĩĩ akũ a akũ.
Awãwã fɔtsa a kĩ baanyɛ bɛtsa mi nyɛ Baguma Onukpɛ̃ Ɔnyɛnɛ Yona fude a.
Foesũ biko anɛ bɛdã flee ntɛ yaatsa fɔsɔ nɛ Kawɛya Luwi akũ.
Mui kayili kĩĩ ketimɔ mui kawɔla amaniɛ a kĩ finyaa bɛkɔa bɛtɛ mi nkpã.
Fɔláalɛ fɔba ntɛ mifɔnɛ be awɛ bisisi mi mbom?
Mabu ye ndɛ ɔkɔba okristoni kĩ yadi ɔnɔkɔali.
Katsɛlɛ Kpalɛwa a lɛ kĩ, “Bati a dzi banya luwi, lɛmɛ be kanya mɔ kamɔa dani fɔkɛna bavɛ kawuga, mɔ litsolewɛ mɔ linyolewɛ kakɛna.
Mi kalɛkadã kɛtana nɛ sukɛna kalɔla ndɛ tɔlɔ kasui, sika ngbã fɔtsa kado, mɔ tilima kĩ tɛtɛ kɔya kadzi kamɛ.
“Lɔkɔ a kĩ ntsɛ̃ manaa, kĩ kite sukuloo mawo Damasko, ndɛ suwa tɔdɔũ ewua-nviã kamɛ a ni, deedimɔapɛ ɔhaĩ mɔ ɔsĩ odi to ode ɛka eko nɛ yĩ akũ!
” Ke liti a, bɛta be tɔkɔlɔ bɛnadzɛla nɛ ɔwɔ abuĩ, bɛfɔnɛ lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa awɛ biyi ade bitomɔ Yesu nɛ liti a.
Yuda mɔ Sila kĩ bɛnyɛ Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ nyɛ fɔlɛtsa pii kayɔ bɛtsa be nɛ lɔkɔ gɛlɛɛlɛ kamɛ, bido be kɔbɛ̃ lɛmɛ.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ edeĩ kɔbɛ̃ kĩ yalɛ kɔdzɛla nɛ tide ahɔlɔ ahɔlɔ kamɛ ni, eke Baguma aduli ɛkpa ye foe kayɔkanyɛ kɔbɛ̃ lɛmɛ, lɔkɔa ɛnyɛ lɛtsa a kĩ de ɛlɛ a kayɔ yededeede.
Yesu ɔma na nɛ awã, ade bɛvɛ Yesu mɔ ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a lɛmɛ bɛya nɛ obolitsɔ̃ kapikɔ̃ a.
Futetsa a mbɔɛɛ kĩ afɔlibɔ atɛnyɛ a kĩ ye lɛkpalɛ futetsa a akũ a?
Ntɛ kanyi kĩĩ bɛtanyi lɛtsama nɛ kadzi nɛ osi kpĩĩ akũ ni, kufɛ fɔnɛnɛ kɔlaa fɔkpa be kɛba kĩ binyi osi wĩ kĩĩ lɛmɛ bibuki bimuniki nɛ mbla kpalɛwa a kĩ Baguma kpa be a liti.
Anɛ ayɔɔla mi mɔ ɔsĩ mɔ ɔsĩ nɛ fɔtsa akũ, lɛmɛ mi awɛ tata foe, nɛ foesũ miawɛ sɔwã kanɔ kawũ.
Ade kĩ bɔnɛ nɛ mbɛtahu kamɛ a, bɔyamɔ kĩ tite a kĩ mui tsua bisinya te a bavɛ Malta.
Ade ke bikĩ bɛdzɛ nɛ Paulo ɔwɛ̃ a via ye kĩ, “Ɔsɔfɔnɔkɔɛ̃ Flee ovũna lɔmɔ?
Fukĩĩ liti a, Paulo dzakũ nɛ Atene ɛnaa Korinto.
Luwi a Petro mɔ Yohanes naa Asɔli Kɔla kamɛ nɛ lɔkɔ a kĩ Yudafɔ abɔa mpaɛ a kamɛ.
Awã na Yesu via be kĩ, “Abodoo eni minɛɛ?
Nɛ boe Ɔlate a sũ ni, kawɔlɛ de yĩ paa kĩ nɛ lɔkɔ gɛlɛɛlɛ liti a, mibuki mina osi miatsa kĩ miakɔna yĩ akũ.
Yudafɔ a kĩ bɛnyɛ be nɛ awɔba kamɛ a kĩ bito Kirene mɔ Aleksandria bibumɔ bikĩ bito Kilikia mɔ Asia yidza nɛ Stefano akũ, bɛkavɛlɛ fɔlɛtsa mɔ ye.
Fɔnyɛ kɔnyɔã fɔkpa otsole kĩ yalɛ kɔdzɛla nɛ batɛ badonɛ katsɛnakɔ̃ a.
Kitonɛkĩ Baguma lɛgãkanya a lɛnyɛ́ onukpɛ̃ kamɛ fɔlɛtsa kalɛ kɛkɛ, mbom fɔnyɛ kɔbɛ̃ fɔlɛtsa.
Ntɛ fɔlɛtsa a kĩ bɛtsɛlɛ nɛ Mose mbla a mɔ Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ tuvoli a kamɛ a ndo.
Baabɔɛ nɔ malo bɛnaabila.
Kĩ fɔkɔ ka a, bati kpã be bakɔba a kĩ basɔ fɔsɔ kumɛkumɛ a bɛma Yesu.
Be tɔlɔ la ndɛ batsole tide, ade be adɔ̃ la ndɛ dzata ade a.
Baguma lisĩ, kitonɛkĩ ade ye lɛfɔ̃ kutse a bo anɛ a.
Mifɔ̃ bɔnyɛ Baguma boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo Ɔlɛga a kɔlɛ, kitonɛkĩ nɛ ayekĩ bɔkɛna ɔmɔa mɔ Kristo sũ ni, ɛkpa boe hũhũ kamɛ nhila adi nyɛ adi kĩ edeĩ nɛ ode katinya a kamɛ a.
Kĩ binu kĩ batɛ badonɛ kĩĩ kalɛ kɔdzɛla nɛ be kamɛ odi nyɛ odi tide kamɛ a, fɔkɛna be wãwã.
Bati aakɛna fukĩĩ nɛ mi akũ kitonɛkĩ bɛtányi Ɔlɛga a ĩye yĩ.
Odi nyɛ odi etse fɔlɛtsa mɔatsɛ, lɛmɛ ɛtawɛ sɔwa ɛlɛ kɔdzɛla mɔatsɛ mɔatsɛ ĩye ɛna kalɔkpa mɔatsɛ mɔatsɛ.
Ade be nyɛ Simon Petro, Toma kĩ bavɛ Ata obi, mɔ Nataniel kĩ eto Kana nɛ Galilea tite akũ, mɔ Zebedeo babi mɔ Yesu fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ bɛbã nviã.
Ke liti a, Yesu nyɛ bati a flee osi ade bɛdzakũ a.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ yawɛ bati kalɛ ni, Baguma obi yanɛ ade enyina Baguma a.
Bite Paulo lɛmɛ kĩ Herme, kitonɛkĩ ade ye lɛdza ɛkalɛ kɔdzɛla a.
Foesũ finyaa minaa ɔmatɔ a tɔblɔnu kpale akũ minaavɛ odi nyɛ odi kĩ míamɔ ɛya nɛ kanyakɔ̃ a.
Lɛmɛ kalɛ ɔnɔkɔali a nyɛ kĩ Baguma dzɛla Kristo etomɛna kanɔkpa ade fɔnyɛ kasipi kĩ bikĩ biku a ni, yaadzɛla be malo.
’ Ade baabi kɔtɔbii kĩ, ‘Mikɔla boe!
Kitonɛkĩ ndɛ ayekĩ wuda tsã oti akũ ɛya nɛ katinya kamɛ a, ade aye bati kayidza kato kanɔkpa lɛmɛ tsã oti akũ a.
Nɛ mbla a onukpɛ̃ ni, Levi babi mɔ bawa kĩ banya basɔfɔ a deĩ osi kĩ batɛ fɔtsa kasɛ̃ kamɛ katsu kawuade nɛ Israelfɔ awɛ, titɔ kĩ be malo bɛnyɛ Abraham kasinu kamɛ babi malo.
Yesu via ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a kĩ, “Nde sũ libe wo mi lɔmɔ?
Bɔabu bati kĩ bado ɔwɔlɛ nɛ lubo kamɔ kamɛ kĩ kawɔlɛ bati.
Ade lɔkɔ a na kamɛ lɛmɛ mɔ Baguma ɔlɛdo ya ɛkpa Yohanes kĩ ɛnyɛ Zakaria obi a kĩ ɛna nɛ kɔsa kamɛ a.
Nwaɛ̃ amɛ flee a kĩ bideĩ nɛ awĩ bo nwɔ̃na mi nkpa be tsoo!
Ade obisɛ̃de a bi ɔlɛga kĩ, ‘Papa, kɔa adzapadiɛ a kĩ yaanya yĩ kanyakɔ̃ a kakpa yĩ finyaa.
Oti odi nake foe, ɛdani ɛkɔla foe.
“Nwaɛ̃ amɛ, finyaakĩĩ ĩnyina kĩ mi mɔ mi banɔkɔɛ̃ mikɛna fukĩĩ nɛ Yesu akũ nɛ katanyi kamɛ.
“Ebi yĩ kĩ, ‘Yidza kanaa Damasko ɔmatɔ a kamɛ.
Mbom kɔ́ana nɛ awã kĩ Baguma yi ɛkpa nɛ boe adzuma kakɛna kamɛ, ade boe adzuma nɛ mi kamɛ lɛmɛ bu a.
Nkavila kĩ ɔsa okesĩnɛ a yasɔ mi ɛdã, lɔkɔa boe adzuma kakɛna a flee kɛna pupulidza.
Ndani anɛ kĩ madã oti a kĩ ɛlamɛna yĩ kalɛ kabi a, ade mmɔ́ sika ngbã ɔsɛdza titse evũkɔnɔ a.
Ntɛ odi kɔna kĩ enyina fɔtsa nɛ litsedi akũ paa ni, ɛtámɔ foe kamɔ wĩ ndɛ ayekĩ kɛnɛ kĩ fɔna a.
Ade kawũ banɔnɛ banɔkɔɛ̃ mɔ ɔmatɔ a kamɛ banɔkɔɛ̃ a tomɔ be bɛya a.
Nɛ foesũ midɔla akũ mido nɛ Baguma kɔbɛ̃ awɛ a kayɔ, ayekĩ yaadɛla mi nɛ ode nɛ ye mɔawɛ lɔkɔ wĩ a kamɛ.
” Ntɛ mikɛna foe lɔmɔ a, lɔkɔa fɔátsa kĩ adzuni kpa mikɔa miadzɛ mi fɔlɛtsa, kĩ miado ntsitsemu lɛmɛ nɛ mi kamɛ?
Nɛ foesũ mitɛ ye mɔ kawɔlɛ ndɛ ɔwaɛ̃ nɛ boe Ɔlate dĩ akũ.
Foesũ ɛfɔ̃ bɛnatsua Yohanes lɔlɔ nɛ kɔla a kamɛ.
Oyitsɔ̃ kĩĩ tomɔ boe mɔ Paulo mɔ fɔwɔla kabɔa kĩ, “Baguma Kpale basumunɛ bati kĩĩ anɛ, ade bɛya nɛ awĩ kĩ bayaatsa mi nkpã kana osi a!
Ade ayea mi bapopo lɛmɛ midɔla mi akũ mikpa mi banɔkɔɛ̃ a.
Yesu dzakũ nɛ awã ade bɛmɔ ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a bɛnaa ɔmatɔ a kĩ ye kamɛ bɛdɔɔla ye a.
Nɛ foesũ sodzafɔ a kĩ badzɔlɛ lɛgã tɔtɔ akũ a flee, mɔ bati bɛbã a kĩ bideĩ nɛ awĩ a mɔ́ biyi ɔsũ kĩ Kristo sũ mɔ nwaa kɔla.
Yesu ku nɛ boe lɔlɔ, kĩ ntɛ budzi o-o, ĩye ntɛ buku o-o, bɔ́adzimɔ ye nɛ ye kabuki kaya kamɛ.
Bidzi nɛ batɛ badonɛ nɛ Antiokia sɛkɛ̃ owi buna kɔlaa.
Nfɔ̃ bɛvɛlɛ be sɔtɔ nɛ Yudafɔ fɔlɛtsa kadzɛkɔ̃ flee, ndza nɛ be akũ kĩ bɛlɛ fubusuotsa nɛ Yesu akũ.
Ntɛ bunyina kĩ yatse lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa a kĩ bɔavia ye ni, kekɔ̃ bunyina lɛmɛ kĩ lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa kĩ bɔavia ni, bɔatɛ katomɛna ye sɛkɛ̃.
Kitonɛkĩ kayɔkanyɛ futefute deĩ kĩ foe sũ banyole lɛláapuli bɛkɔã batsɔ̃.
Nɛ kĩ fɔlɛtsa kĩ fɔtagba sũ ni, mifɔ̃ budo be libe kĩ bɛtabi odima kalɛ nɛ Yesu dĩ akũ.
Midɔla mi akũ mikpa Baguma, ayekĩ míapuli mitɛ ye kalɛ a kĩ edu nɛ mi tɔwɔlɛ kamɛ a, kĩ kaafɔ̃ mina nkpã katɛ a.
Kĩ biwo Asɔli Kɔla onyukpɛ̃ a kĩ bavɛ Onyukpɛ̃ Mɔ Kalɛ a, bɛmɔ́ onyole odi kĩ eveliveli kito ye lɛmawi, kĩ ɛwaa nɛ awã.
Kĩ Apolo yake otse kĩ yaanaa Akaia, batɛ badonɛ nɛ Efeso a yado ye kɔbɛ̃.
Ye katɛkado kamɛ ɛtsã ɛna Baguma adansiɛ nɛ ye akũ kĩ ɛnyɛ oti kpĩĩ, kitonɛkĩ Baguma mɔawɛ lɛtɛ ye futetsa a.
Yesu sua ovoli a emunikimɔ ye ɛkpa fɔtsa akũ ɔdãmɛnanɛ a, ade ɛkɛna akũ edzi a.
Kĩ bido ye atadiɛ ngbã biyua a, bifuã ye bibi ye kĩ, “Yiiduu!
Ade ayea fɔkɛna ye adzuma bakɔba Yakobo mɔ Yohanes kĩ bɛnyɛ Zebedeo babi a lɛmɛ wãwã a.
Ntɛ epuli ɛnya sɔhuiɛ a akũ ni, Baguma aakpa ye nkpã a kĩ ɛlɛ eyi ɛkpa bati a kĩ bawɛ ye kalɛ a.
Fɔtsa katsa a na la ndɛ kaakpa kĩ kasa kaba sukɛna.
Bite oti lɔlɔ a nɛ tsensi akũ bɛyamɛna, ade bɛkɔa bɛkpa oyitsɔ̃ a, ade ye malo ɛkɔa de ɛma ɔma a.
“Ntɛ fudeĩ ɔsĩ fɔmɔ Baguma aatɛ bati kpĩĩ bɛna nkpã ni.
Bɛkpa nɔ foe bɛtsãmɛna Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ akũ nɛ fɔlɛtsa a kĩ bɛlɛ biyi a kamɛ nɛ lɔkɔ a kĩ asɔli banɔkɔɛ̃ te awɛ nɛ nɔ akũ a.
Dɔũhuilɛ mɔapɛ kamɛ bɛkɔ nɔ kɔtɔ!
Finyaa yĩ fɔlɛtsa a kĩ mbi mi a kpalɛ mi akũ kɔkɔɛ.
Nɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ akũ ni, odima ɛtakɛna tɔkpa nɛ ɔkɔba akũ ĩye esisi ye.
Lɛmɛ makɛna foe ndɛ lɛtsa a kĩ bihihiɛ bɛkpa yĩ kĩ nkɛna, kitonɛkĩ fɔnyɛ adzuma kĩ Baguma hihiɛ ɛkpa yĩ.
Bɛmɔ́ litsedi ndɛ fi fɔmɛ kĩ fɔka fudzi nɛ odi nyɛ odi akũ.
Nɛ awã a ɛmɔ Yudani odi kĩ bavɛ Akwila kĩ eto Ponto.
Lɛmɛ boe a kĩ butomɔ ye a budzi ɔkɔlɔ bɔnya ye lɔtɔ kĩ bɔ́anatsɛlamɔ akũ nɛ awã, lɔkɔa bɔbɔɛ ye ndɛ ayekĩ ɛtsa a.
Nláapuli ĩnyɛ boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo kɔlɛ nɛ kɔbɛ̃ a kĩ ɛkpa yĩ nnɛɛ makɛna adzuma wĩ kĩĩ akũ.
Ntɛ ntakɛna fɔtsa kĩ odima tákɛna tɔ̃ nɛ be kamɛ ni, kufɛ bɛtákɛna tɔkpa, lɛmɛ kĩ finyaa bɛmɔ́ fɔtsa a kĩ nkɛna a malo ni, bakesĩ bɔmɔ Nda.
Takɔ oti, tanɛ kɔnyɔ ĩye kɔtsɔ̃ liti, taye, tama fɔvã ote nɛ oti akũ, tasisi oti, mɔ bu aga mɔ ama.
Ntɛ bide lɛtsã nɛ Baguma fɔlɛtsa a akũ biyua a, ɔyaɛ kpa a kĩ eto lɛkɛ dzununuunu kamɛ ɛnɛ a, aanɔ kawũ mɔ be.
Foesũ lɛ kalɛ mɔapɛ lɔkɔa yĩ ɔsumunɛ a aasaɛ.
Fɔlɛtsa badzɛnɛ a fɔ̃ bɛyɛlɛ tɛtadiɛ nɛ be akũ, ade bɛkpa kɔbɛ̃ kĩ bibo be mɔ kutse a.
Nlámɔ kalɛ kĩ yĩ awɛ tá lɛtsa a kĩ mawɛ ĩye kĩ nkpɔla kɔkɔɛ.
Kitonɛkĩ bɛkɔ Kristo kĩ ɛnyɛ boe Wuda Katɛ̃ kavelibi bɛkɔa bɛbɔa afɔliɛ nɛ boe lɔlɔ.
Ade mialɛ kĩ, ‘Ntɛ budzi nkpã nɛ boe bawanyɔ lɔkɔ a ni, kufɛ bɔtákɛna ɔmɔa mɔ be bɔkɔ Baguma onukpɛ̃ banyɛnɛ a.
Lɛmɛ Baguma mɔ́ yĩ kɔnya, kitonɛkĩ nɛ lɔkɔ a na kamɛ ni, ntátɛ ye ndo ade ntányi lɛtsa a kĩ de nkakɛna a.
Awã naa, ebi be fɔlɛtsa nɛ Baguma lɛgãkanyakɔ̃ a akũ.
Kito kɛyawo nviã lɔkɔ kĩĩ malo budzi kɔlɛ mɔ ɔmɔado, budeĩ nɛ tɛtadiɛ kpeliwa kamɛ, babo boe, ade bɔtsɛ̃ bɔato katɛ̃ kĩ bɔlá kadzikɔ̃.
Lɛtsa a kĩ Kristo mɔawɛ lɛ eyi kĩ yaakpa boe nyɛ nkpã kĩ ɛlá kawũna a.
Ntsɛlɛ ye mamɛna bati a kĩ Baguma pau, kĩ bɛgba biko ndɛ banɔvɔɛ̃ aye nɛ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia mɔ Bitinia amantam kamɛ a.
Lɛnyɛ a na, ɛkpã be ɛnasu be fɔkpa, ade ye mɔ ye tɔtɔ kamɛ bati bɛtɛ mui kawɔla amaniɛ a.
Nɛ lɔkɔa na kamɛ ni, Yudani odi ya nɛ Efeso.
Yudafɔ mbla a lɛnyɛ́ fɔtsa wĩ a kutidu, mbom ɛla ndɛ fɔtsa wĩ a kĩ fɔ́aya a kuyo kɛkɛ.
” Kĩ be bakesĩnɛ a dza bɛkadã a, bide bɛnaa ode nɛ luflututu kamɛ.
Lɛmɛ Yesu kpa mbuayɛ kĩ, “Katsɛlɛ Kpalɛwa a lɛ kĩ, ‘Nnɛ́ funitsã odi sũ oti adzi nkpã, mbom edzi nkpã nɛ kalɛ nyɛ kalɛ kĩ kanɛ kato Baguma onukpɛ̃ kamɛ a akũ.
Bɛkpa ɔyaɛ kpa a osi kĩ ɛlɛ kukũpia mɔ fubusuotsa pii ɛnya akũ tidetɔ tɛna-nviã.
Kitonɛkĩ ntɛ mbɔa mpaɛ nɛ tide ahɔlɔ ahɔlɔ kamɛ ni, yĩ hũhũ kɔ̃ bɔa mpaɛ lɛmɛ yĩ adzuni lɛláa foe kamɛ.
Ade ode fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ ɔyade a naa ɛnatsokui ye kɔɔpu kamɛ fɔtsa a eko nɛ mpo kamɛ a.
Awã naa, Romafɔ sodzafɔ ɔnɔkɔɛ̃ odi nɛ awã na ɔsumunɛ kĩ yaátunɔ kalɛ.
Yuda mɔ ɔtsɔ̃ Tamai ma Perez mɔ Zera.
Bɛtábɔa onyole bɛkpa otsole nɛ ye otsole a kalɛ sũ, lɛmɛ bɛkɛna otsole bɛkpa nɛ onyole a kalɛ sũ.
Ade nnɛ́ Adam Abonsam kɛ, mbom otsole a ɛkɛ ade ɛfɔ̃ efum Baguma mbla a.
Foesũ bɛnyɛ bati nviã ade be nyɛ Matias mɔ Yosef kĩ bavɛ Barsaba kĩ babuki kavɛ Yusto a.
Ade ke Farisifɔ a badi via be kĩ, “Nde sũ miakɛna lɛtsa a kĩ boe mbla tákpa osi kĩ bɛkɛna nɛ Kawɛya Luwi akũ?
Lɛmɛ nɛ ɔnɔkɔali kamɛ ni, Yesu mɔawɛ táwɔla odima mui, mbom ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a odi lɛwɔla bati mui.
Elihud ma Eleazar, Eleazar ma Matan, ade Matan ma Yakob.
Nɛ kĩ oni kako osili lɛmɛ na sũ ni, bɛkpɔta fi kpale nɛ mpo abuĩ a bɛkpa boe.
Onesimo, boe ɔwaɛ̃ kĩ yadi ɔnɔkɔali, kĩ ɛnyɛ mi kamɛ ɔmɔa a, aatomɔ ye bɛya nɛ mi sɛkɛ̃.
Titɔ kĩ edeĩ nɛ Baguma kutidu kamɛ malo ni, ɛtákɔna kĩ yakɔa ye kɔbɛ̃ ɛtsa kĩ bɛmɔ Baguma biketi.
Kɔawũ babi titi ewua-nviã nɛ kateli mɔa kamɛ, nɛ odetɔ mɔa kamɛ deedi.
Odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛtɛ Baguma onukpɛ̃ ɔnyɛnɛ nɛ kĩ ɛnyɛ Baguma onukpɛ̃ ɔnyɛnɛ sũ ni, yaana kɔtɔkase a kĩ Baguma aakpa ye a kamɛ.
Lɛmɛ Baguma nyɛ Lot, oti kpĩĩ kĩ bati ɔbla kpa kabɔa kaha ye ɔwɔlɛ.
Mi babisɛ̃, mi nlamɛna ovoli kĩĩ katsɛlɛ kama, kitonɛkĩ bɛkɔa mi tɔkpa bite mi nɛ Kristo sũ.
Deedimɔapɛ ye abɔa mɔ anya flee de ɔsĩ, ade ɛvɛnya ɛdza nɛ abɔa akũ, edo katokatɛ̃ awɛ a.
Yesu buki ɛlɛ kĩ, “Lɛmɛ mabi mi kĩ Baguma onukpɛ̃ ɔnyɛnɛ odima látɛ dĩ wĩ nɛ ye mɔawɛ ɔmatɔ.
Ade foe nyɛ lɛtsa a kĩ lanɛ kato bikĩ babɔa ye dĩ ndɛ boe Ɔlate ayea tunukpɛ̃ a.
Baguma boe Ɔlɛga mɔ boe Ɔlate Yesu Kristo bɛmɔ mi kɔnya, bɛkpa mi lukudɔ lɛmɛ.
Nɛ tidetɔ elo a na kamɛ ni, bati aawɛ wuda, lɛmɛ bɛláana ye, baawɛ kĩ baku lɛmɛ wuda aalo be.
“Odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛtɛ mi ni, ɛtɛ yĩ malo, ade odi nyɛ odi kĩ ɛtɛ yĩ ni, ɛtɛ oti a kĩ edo yĩ a.
Ade aye kɛnɛ kĩ midza pintii nɛ mi nkpã kadzi kamɛ nɛ boe Ɔlate a dĩ akũ a.
Midã kadã wĩ nɛ bakpete a kĩ bɛdzɛ̃ nɛ mi akũ kĩ mitsua mi sukɛna a.
Lɛmɛ ntɛ míamɔ lubo malo nɛ tuwĩ a kĩ miakɛna sũ ni, Baguma ahila mi!
Baguma nyɛ ɛtsa be nɛ kɔda kamɛ kĩ bɛtabuki bɛnaa Herodes sɛkɛ̃, foesũ bimuniki bɛtsã osi bɛbã bɛdzakũ bɛnaa ɔtɔ.
Bɔmɔ́ ye kukũkpalɛ a, kukũkpalɛ a kĩ ɛtɛ ndɛ Ɔlɛga a Obi mɔapɛ a aye.
Manyɛ ye kɔlɛ kĩ ɛmɔ́ kĩ nkpɔla sũ ɛpau yĩ kĩ nkɛna ye adzuma, titɔ kĩ nɛ lɔkɔ lidi kamɛ ni, nsupa ye, ntomɔ ye liti, nvũna ye malo.
Nyansã kĩĩ odu táto ode, mbom katinya kamɛ ade yanɛ, ɛnyɛ́ hũhũ kamɛ ade, hũhũ kpa kamɛ eto.
Lɛmɛ nkɔna kĩ fusĩ kĩ mado boe ɔwaɛ̃ Epafrodito nɛ mi sɛkɛ̃.
Ke kɔ̃ nviã nɛ awĩ!
Ade ayea mi batsɔ̃ midɔla mi akũ mikpa mi banyɔ, ayekĩ ntɛ be kamɛ badi tátɛ Baguma kalɛ a bido malo ni, mi ɔbla wĩ aafɔ̃ bɛtɛ bido.
Lɛmɛ nɛ kĩ Baguma mɔ yĩ kɔnya sũ ni, ɛkɛna yĩ oti a kĩ ye manɛ finyaakĩĩ.
Badi na nɛ baveli ĩye kutukpã tuvoli kamɛ bɛtsã bɛkamini nɛ ohiã kamɛ, bitomɔ be liti ade bɛkɛna be awɔda a.
Kĩ nnaa Yerusalem a, basɔfɔnɔkɔɛ̃ mɔ be banɔkɔɛ̃ a tsua ye onukpɛ̃ bɛkpa yĩ ade bɛwɛ kĩ nkɔ ye kɔtɔ a.
Simon Petro bi boe ayekĩ Baguma nya lɔtɔ ɛnyɛ ye kawɛ ɛtsa bikĩ bɛnyɛ́ Yudafɔ a, ade ɛpau be badi kĩ bɛnya ye bade a.
Perez ma Hezron, Hezron lɛmɛ ma Aram.
Kitonɛkĩ kito anɛ kɔkɔɛ a bakã Mose mbla a kĩ ɛtsɛlɛ eyi a nɛ Kawɛya Luwi lidi nyɛ lidi akũ nɛ Yudafɔ katsɛnakɔ̃ ade bade lɛtsã nɛ ye fɔlɛtsa akũ nɛ ɔmatɔ nyɛ ɔmatɔ kamɛ a.
Ade Abonsam kpã Yesu ɛnamɛna Yerusalem, Ɔmatɔ Kpalɛwa a kamɛ a.
Nɛ foesũ ntɛ odi sĩ nhihiɛ kĩĩ akũ kakɛna ni, nnɛ́ otidziwa esĩ, mbom eyidza ɛdza nɛ Baguma kĩ yakɔa ye Hũhũ Kpalɛwa kakpa mi a akũ.
Yesu bi ye kĩ, “Luwi a onyole odi te opunu ɛvɛ bati beblebee.
Katɛkado lɛfɔ̃ Sara lɛmɛ na kɔbɛ̃ epuli ɛtsãmɔ kɔma, titɔ kĩ ɛkɛna katsɔkpa malo, kitonɛkĩ ebu Baguma a kĩ ɛkpa ye bɔhɛ a ɔnɔkɔalini.
Ade edo yĩ kĩ nde lɛtsã kĩ bikĩ bideĩ nɛ awɔba kamɛ.
Bɛtɛ bido nɛ lɔkɔ lukũ odi kamɛ, ade ntɛ sɔhuiɛ adi ya ni, bamuniki liti.
Budeĩ kɔnɛte kĩĩ bɔkpa boe akũ nɛ boe kadzi kamɛ, ndɛ ayekĩ kutse tunu api koe kadzɛla kpli a.
Lɛmɛ nɛ bati lidede sũ ni, bɛtána osi biwomɔ ye.
Ɔgɔabi láwũ akutu, ade ɔtatsuɛ láwũ asãã babi a.
Ntɛ ĩya ni, maadɛ mi nɛ fɔlɛtsa bɛbã a kĩ fute a akũ.
Edeĩ kɔbɛ̃ kɔlaa ɛbɛ̃ yĩ, ade ntáfɛta kĩ mawũnya mpabua nɛ ye abɔa malo a.
Te awɛ nɛ nɔ bati akũ bɛna kasaɛ, kafɔ̃ awãwã fɔtsa mɔ nsɛntsɛlɛni pii fɔya nɛ nɔ Ɔsumunɛ Kpalɛwa Yesu dĩ akũ.
Baguma ahila tite a, kĩ tamɔa oni mui kafɔ̃ futse amɛ nɛ te akũ kana nfasɔ kakpa bikĩ be sũ banɛ fɔba nɛ te akũ a.
Oti a kĩ edeĩ atɔ ni, etse fɔlɛtsa a kĩ Hũhũ a lamɛna tɛsɔli a kabi!
-Foesũ fusĩ kĩ oti bɛbã ɛyaawo nɛ boe kamɛ ndɛ ɔdansini ɛkpa boe Ɔlate Yesu kayidza kato kanɔkpa a.
Ke liti a, fɔtsa ɔkɔlɛnɛ bɛbã a kĩ ɛnya lɔtɔ ewo linikɛ a ɔwɛ̃ a, lɛmɛ wo nɛ de kamɛ.
Nɛ foesũ ni, kawɔlɛ kide mi ode, mɔ mi a kĩ mideĩ nɛ awã a flee!
Kĩ bɛbɔa mpaɛ biyua a, kɔla kĩ koe kamɛ bɛna a kuna.
Ntɛ kɔlɛ akɔ odi ni, ɛnya nɛ kɔla ayekĩ ntɛ miyatsɛna nɛ Baguma kɔla kamɛ ni owula lɛláana kadzɛ ɛkpa ye akũ.
Yesu bɔa be lɛgbã kĩĩ, lɛmɛ bɛtánu lɛtsa a kĩ yatsa a kayɔ.
Ɛtsa be fɔtsa pii nɛ fɔgbã kamɛ ɛlɛ kĩ, “Luwi a onyole odi naasã kamɔnɛ.
Bati badi kĩ bɛwɛ kĩ babɔɛ fɔlɛtsa nɛ Yesu akũ na nɛ awã, foesũ bivia ye kĩ, “Boe mbla kpa osi kĩ bɛtsa fɔsɔ nɛ Kawɛya Luwi akũ?
” Kĩ Yesu lɛ fukĩĩ eyua a, ebuki ɛkahɔ nɛ Galilea.
“Mivia fɔtsa lɔkɔa baakpa mi, miwɛ fɔtsa lɔkɔa míamɔ foe, mibɔa opunu lɔkɔa baabinya bɛkpa mi.
Lɛtalɛta kɔla tupunu a flee binya ade nkɔsɔnkɔsɔ a wɔlɔ nɛ kɔlabawanɛ a flee akũ tɛtɔ a.
Finyaa kɔ̃ binyina kĩ lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa kĩ ɔkɔa ɔkpa yĩ a flee to nɔ sɛkɛ̃.
Bɛwɛ kĩ bakɔa be nkpã bɛkpa faa ntɛ fɔ́anya wuda malo.
Bɔtsɛlɛ ovoli kĩĩ katsɛlɛ bɔama mi, ayekĩ boe kawɔlɛkamɔ a aakpɔla.
Bati nɛ tite kĩĩ akũ a tɛ boe mɔ kawɔlɛ paa a.
Nɛ lɔkɔ a na kamɛ a, fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a ya nɛ Yesu sɛkɛ̃, bivia ye kĩ, “Owei bɛ̃ flee nɛ ode lɛgãkanyakɔ̃ a kamɛ?
Nwaɛ̃ amɛ, atɔ kutse aapuli kuwũ gowa babi, ĩye akateleku aapuli ewũ atɔ babi, mbɔɛɛ?
Bipi osi ade bɛnamɔ lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa pɛpɛɛpɛ ndɛ ayekĩ Yesu bi be a, ade bɛtɔ Wuda Katɛ̃ funitsã a nɛ awã a.
Awaɛ̃ ɔtɛ odonɛ a kĩ ye katɛkado tábo anɛ, lɛmɛ Kristo ku nɛ ye lɔlɔ a ni, yaawɔ nɛ nɔ kadi a kĩ onyina a sũ.
“Midã, mado mi ndɛ baveli aye nɛ kulikii kamɛ, foesũ minyi kadi ndɛ bɔɛ aye, midɔla akũ bɔɛɛ ndɛ mblɔduma aye.
Yesu lɛ ɛnaa lɔtɔ kĩ, “Onyole odi na babinyole nviã.
Ɛlamɛna boe kadani kanamɛna ye kutidu odu a kamɛ, ade boe kukũkpalɛ lɛmɛ ade nɛ ode kabu a.
Foesũ bimuniki bɛtsã Misia bɛnawo Troa ɔmatɔ a kĩ ɛwaa nɛ mpo abuĩ a kamɛ.
Nɛ lɔkɔ a na kamɛ a, Herodes lɛnya Galilea tite akũ, ade ɔwaɛ̃ Filipo nyá Iturea mɔ Trakoniti tite akũ a.
Misum ye a kĩ ɛkbɔa tite mɔ ode, mpo mɔ mui kĩ banɛ nɛ tite kamɛ a!
Fɔgãkpo tɛya-ana bɛbã keni fusinya lɛgãkpo a, ade banɔkɔɛ̃ tɛya-ana kĩ bido tɛtadiɛ ovoe, bɛtsa sika ngbã fɔgãbɔɛ dzi nɛ foe akũ a.
’ Ade ke Baguma kɛna lɛkpati katsua ndɛ apam aye nɛ Abraham mɔ Ye Baguma kayite a.
“Tsɛlɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ kamɛna Sardis Asɔli a ode fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ a kĩ.
Foesũ, nwaɛ̃ amɛ, mivɛlɛ mi akũ nɛ baviɔ̃ kasum ɔwɛ̃.
Aabi katinya kamɛ bati flee lɛtsa kĩ ɔmɔ́ nɛ awĩ, mɔ fɔtsa a kĩ maanyɛ ntsa nɔ a.
Katɛkado lɛfɔ̃ Yeriko ɔmatɔ foebi a kĩ Israelfɔ tsã bisinya foe fuwi evũkɔnɔ a veliveli.
Ewo ɛnaa ode mɔawɛ a, awã kĩ finyaa ɛnanyɛ ye akũ nɛ Baguma anɛ nɛ boe onukpɛ̃.
Ntɛ odi kɔna kĩ yaapuli ɛkɔa anɛ ete nɛ te akũ ni, ndeĩ kadzakɔ̃ kĩ makɔna lɔmɔ mbɛ̃ oti a na kɔlaa.
Lɛmɛ kĩ Yudafɔ a kĩ bideĩ nɛ Tesalonika nu kĩ Paulo ya ɛlamɛna Baguma kalɛ a katsa nɛ Beroia, bɛnaa awã bɛnado ɔtutũ nɛ bati a kamɛ.
Nɛ kĩ Festo awɛ kĩ Yudafɔ a bɛwɛ ye kalɛ sũ ni, evia Paulo kĩ, “Ɔwɛ kĩ anaa Yerusalem lɔkɔa ndzɛ nɔ fɔlɛtsa a nɛ awã mbɔɛɛ?
Yesu kpa ye mbuayɛ kĩ, “Awã kĩ manaa, ɔláapuli otomɔ yĩ finyaa bɔnaa, lɛmɛ ke liti ni, aatomɔ yĩ liti.
Bubi mi fukĩĩ tɔ̃, buke mi awɛ nɛ akũ mɔ ɔsĩ mɔ ɔsĩ kĩ boe Ɔlate aavɛlɛ bikĩ bakɛna fɔtsa kĩĩ bamɛ a sɔtɔ.
Ade fukĩĩ sũ Baguma vɛ mi a, kitonɛkĩ Kristo mɔawɛ a malo mɔ́ lubo nɛ mi lɔlɔ, ɛkɔa foe ɛtsa mi nfantuhũ kĩ míatsã ye abɔa kakekɔ̃.
Ntɛ bɛta oti a, fɔawo ndɛ ayekĩ kakpɔ̃na kata aye.
Bati dza nɛ ɔwɔ lutubu baũ a abuĩ ade Yesu katsa be fɔtsa nɛ fɔgbã kamɛ a.
Fɔkɛna be wãwã paa kĩ bɛmɔ́ kĩ ye mɔ otsole bɛlamɛna kɔdzɛla kalɛ.
Otidziwa odima lɛláapuli ɛkɔlɛ ɔnɔ a na, mbɔɛntɛ bati mpim ɔha tɛna-ana a kĩ be odi lɔlɔ kɔtɔ bise nɛ tite akũ a.
Mose akũ Baguma mbla a tsã ɛya, lɛmɛ ye kɔnyakamɔ mɔ ɔnɔkɔali a tsã Yesu Kristo akũ fɔya.
Ovoli kĩĩ to yĩ, Petro, Yesu Kristo fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ sɛkɛ̃.
Nfɔ̃ emuniki yaya nɛ nɔ sɛkɛ̃, ade fɔakɛna yĩ ndɛ yĩ ɔwɔlɛ flee tomɔ ye a.
Yaanɛ eto lɛkɛ dzununuunu a kamɛ ɛyaatɛ̃ ɛnaa bɛwɔla ye.
Fɔtsa katsa kĩĩ a deĩ nɛ Kalɛ Wĩ a kĩ bɛkɔa bido nɛ yĩ awɛ kĩ nlɛ a kamɛ.
Mbla a kĩ Kristo kpa boe nyɛ kĩ odi nyɛ odi kĩ yawɛ Baguma kalɛ ni, ɛwɛ ɔwaɛ̃ lɛmɛ kalɛ.
Kitonɛkĩ boe flee bɔakɛna nfumusu pii.
Lɛmɛ ntáwɛ kĩ mahɛ nɔ kĩ kpa yĩ kabumɛna, mbom mawɛ kĩ kɛna foe futo nɔ ɔwɔlɛ kamɛ.
Bati a kĩ bite bidzi nkpã a flee, kĩ bɛtákɔ be nɛ lubo kamɔ kĩĩ kamɛ a, támuniki nɛ fɔtsa a kĩ be mɔawɛ bɛkɔa awɛ bɛmɛ a kasum liti.
Fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ gba nɛ Yesu batomɛnanɛ a kamɛ kĩ fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ kĩĩ lɛláaku.
Ke liti a, ɛkɔa mui ɛtsɛka mɔ kutukpabi mɔ banantsue babɔanɛ, ɛkɔa kuveli tɛtsã mɔ tuwĩ mɔ ɔlɛ̃ ɛta ade ɛnyɛ ɛsã nɛ mbla ovoli a mɔ bati a flee akũ.
Ade finyaakĩĩ lɛtsa nyɛ lɛtsa kĩ lɛkɛna lɔkɔɛ ni, owi lɛláabuna mɔ laatɛ̃ lɛnaa.
Hũhũ Kpalɛwa a Kaya Nɛ Pentekoste Luwi a Akũ.
Ade Yudani mbla ɔtsanɛ odi kĩ ɛna nɛ awã a, nu fɔlɛtsa kamɛ kasa a.
Ɛvɛ ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ ewua-nviã a ɛkpɔta, ade edo be nviã nviã a.
Luwi a, kĩ Yesu katsa fɔtsa a, Farisifɔ mɔ Yudafɔ mbla batsanɛ a kĩ bito tɛmatɔ kumɛkumɛ nɛ Galilea mɔ Yudea tite akũ, mɔ Yerusalem na nɛ awã.
Nda, fɔ̃ be malo bɛna nɛ boe kamɛ ndɛ ayekĩ odeĩ nɛ yĩ kamɛ, ade yĩ malo ndeĩ nɛ nɔ kamɛ a.
Ade fukĩĩ kamɛ bunyi lɛtsa a kĩ liti lɛnyɛ ɔdɔ a.
Boe Ɔlate, ade fukĩĩ sũ Yudafɔ a bɔɛ fɔlɛtsa nɛ yĩ akũ a.
Nɛ futeli nviã liti a, bɛnyɛ Felike ade bɛkɔa Porkio Festo bɛyamɛna nɛ ye kadzakɔ̃ a.
Luwi a ke olobe a, Yesu vɛ ye fɔtsa bakɔlɛnɛ a ɛlɛ kĩ, “Mifɔ̃ bunyina ɔwɔ lutubu baũ a bɔnaa de abuĩ atide a.
Ade deedimɔapɛ tite kuna mɔ ɔsĩ mɔ ɔsĩ ade kɔla a flee kuna kɔnake a.
“Tsɛlɛ fɔlɛtsa kĩĩ kama Efeso asɔli a ode fɔtɔ ɔnyanɛ a.
Awã na bɛkabɔa fɔwɔla kĩ, “Bati badi tsɛ̃mɔ ɔtutũ kado nɛ kakɔ nyɛ kakɔ, ade bɛkɔa foe bɛyamɛna nɛ awĩ kĩĩ lɛmɛ a.
Ntɛ odi lɛlá katɛkado ni, ye fɔlɛtsa lɛláawo Baguma anɛ, kitonɛkĩ odi nyɛ odi kĩ yaya nɛ Baguma sɛkɛ̃ ni, kɛnɛ kĩ ɛna katɛkado kĩ Baguma deĩ, ade ɛnyɛ bikĩ bawɛ ye liti osi a kɔtɔ osenɛ a.
Salmon mɔ Rahab ma Boaz, ade Boaz mɔ Rut ma Obed a.
Yudafɔ banɔkɔɛ̃ a kawɛ ye nɛ luwi a kanyakɔ̃, bɛkavia kĩ, “Nde oti a?
Mi bapopo, ntsɛlɛ mma mi, kitonɛkĩ mideĩ kɔbɛ̃, Baguma kalɛ a deĩ nɛ mi kamɛ, ade minya Oti Kpa a akũ a.
Ade fɔláasĩ malo kĩ miabinya onukpɛ̃ milɛ kadima, kitonɛkĩ baamɔ ayekĩ mi ɔbla kabɔa nɛ Baguma kavila kamɛ kpalɛ mi akũ.
fuketimɔ ayekĩ edzi nɛ akũ kahɛhɛ mɔ nkpã kanya kamɛ a.
Baguma hila oti a kĩ ɛtamɔ́ nfumusu adima nɛ yĩ akũ.
Foesũ biwula atsɛ biwo nɛ bati a kamɛ, bɛbɔa fɔwɔla kĩ, “Nda amɛ, nde sũ miakɛna fukĩĩ odu?
Ayekĩ bati pii fɔli nɛ ye akũ sũ ni, ewo edzi nɛ ɔkɔlɔ kĩ eteĩ nɛ mui anɛ kamɛ.
Ntɛ ɔta fu sɛnɛta ni, nɔ mɔawɛ akũ opila.
